# Review - PR 582 @ 9bd12f2d31e1608ab1aa33765c6fb4da2f6e05bf

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: dc959fca6c55a732cd753ae543e180b5b883f51e. A documentation-only preservation packet of three files (+104/-12): one Lean module docstring correction and two blueprint chapters, with no theorem statement, definition or proof change.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Base is `main`; reviewed the published head against `base=0f437c4566a3613dc3942a2cc06ca82a72b462ed` (the merge base with `github/main`). The worktree HEAD equals the published head. No earlier marked review exists on this PR, so there were no prior findings to re-check.

Scope checked, file by file.

`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points.lean:7-8` - the docstring now says the module "constructs the projective joint X/Z point measurements" instead of "states the construction obligation". Verified against the module at this head: `exists_combinedPointsWitness` is a complete proof (no `sorry`/`admit`/`axiom`/`native_decide` anywhere in the diff or in the cited support file), and the witness it builds carries a projectivity field discharged from `exists_projective_close_sandwich_alice/bob`. The old wording was stale; the new wording is accurate.

`ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:53-63` (coefficient-representative convention). The added text says `\deg_k(\ell)` holds univariate representatives given by `k+1` coefficients under the convention of `def:ideg-deg-polynomials`, and that distinct representatives stay distinct outcomes. Checked against `def:ideg-deg-polynomials` (ch14:38) and `rem:deg-line-representatives` (ch14:94): both already adopt the coefficient reading, so the new paragraph restates them rather than introducing a new convention. The example is correct - `t^q - t` has degree `q`, hence lies in `\deg_k` exactly when `k >= q`, and induces the zero function on `F_q`. The claim "admissibility does not require `md<q`" is correct against `AdmissibleParams` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/PauliBasisTest.lean:37-43`: `1 <= d`, `IsAdmissibleSize q`, `m | q`, and nothing bounding `md`); e.g. `q = m = 8`, `d = 1` gives `md = q`.

`ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:844-932`, new node `lem:combined-point-distance-support`. Compared each of the four items with its `\lean` target in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Closeness.lean` at this head:
item 1 = `opFamilyDistSq_uniform_le_four:47` (nonempty finite question set, uniform distribution, unit vector, both families square-summable to at most `1`, bound `4`) - matches, including the hypotheses;
item 2 = `sum_mul_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_one:87` and the primed variant at `:116`, both over the pair index `(a,b)` with projectivity of both measurements and no commutation hypothesis - matches;
item 3 = `ProjectiveSetting.chain_bounds:141` - hypotheses `hQR/h₁/h₂/h₃` and the three conclusions match the TeX one for one, including the orientation of each family (`Z_i X_i` is `pointMeasExp .Z * pointMeasExp .X`), the quantification over every placement and every opposite pair, and the exact constants `(2,4,4)`, `(4,8,8,2)`, `(12,20,16,4)`;
item 4 = `error_terms_le_rpow_eighth:225` - matches, including `0 <= eps <= 1` and `C_0 >= 1`.
`R_i` is described as the `Z`-`X`-`Z` sandwich; `sandwichPoint` (`Points/Sandwich.lean:102-108`) is indeed `M^Z_b M^X_a M^Z_b`. The `\uses` list is accurate: `def:symmetric-equivalents` resolves to `Placement`/`IsOpposite`/`place`, which is exactly what `chain_bounds` quantifies over. `\leanok` on statement and proof is sound: all five declarations exist, are `sorry`-free, and are reached by the green `local-ci/build` at this head.

`ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1288-1320`, `lem:concrete-paired-line-degree-support` gains the orientation claim and `combinedLineMeasurement_effect_eq_pastedMeasurement`. Verified the arithmetic of the exchange: `eq:pasting-2a` (ch12:1028) is `J_{g1,g2} = (G_2)_{g2} (G_1)_{g1} (G_2)_{g2}`, so with `G_1 = Z`-line and `G_2 = X`-line, `J_{f_Z,f_X} = X_{f_X} Z_{f_Z} X_{f_X}`, which is the sandwich of `def:concrete-paired-line-measurement`. The Lean side agrees: `pastedMeasurement M₁ M₂ g₁ g₂ = M₂ g₂ * M₁ g₁ * M₂ g₂` (`Games/Sandwich/Defs.lean:66-69`) applied as `pastedMeasurement (lineMeasExp .Z lineZ).effect (lineMeasExp .X lineX).effect fZ fX`. The added proof sentence correctly disclaims any consistency content, matching the `rfl` proof and the existing separate obligation `lem:combined-line-measurement-consistency`.

`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1807-1916` is wording only: two sentences that narrated "the formalization" are rewritten as mathematics ("an equivalent argument reverses the order of the estimates"), in line with the no-Lean-jargon rule for blueprint prose. No estimate, constant or dependency changed, and the `\leanok`/`\uses` on that proof are untouched.

Duplication and reuse: the diff adds no Lean declaration, so there is nothing that could duplicate an existing one; all six newly linked names already exist on `main` and none of them is linked from any other blueprint node (checked by `git grep` over `blueprint/src` at this head), so the two new links introduce no duplicate node. The commit subject follows `type(scope): short description` under 72 characters, the branch name is bracket-free, the PR body has Motivation/Description/Testing, and no commit message contains a closing reference.

Exact-head CI: `local-ci/summary` success, with `build`, `blueprint-render`, `blueprint-sync`, `paper-gaps`, `file-length`, `proof-debt`, `proof-evasion` and `statement-origin` all success.

One non-blocking observation, recorded rather than raised as a finding because the referent is fixed by the next sentence and nothing is mathematically wrong: at `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:893` the shorthand `X_{i,a} Z_{i,b}` is introduced one sentence before the clause that identifies these as the expanded point measurements at placement `i`; the chapter's explicit notation elsewhere is `\hat M^{(Point,X),x}_a`.

Not checked: the original PR 398 and its history (out of scope by the stated instruction); the untouched proofs and statements on `main` that these nodes link to, beyond the signatures compared above; I ran no build of my own and relied on the green exact-head `local-ci/build` for elaboration of the single touched Lean file, whose change is confined to a module docstring.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)
